name: com.squirrelbrainapp/squirrel-brain
description: Create alarms, read tasks, send voice messages to your phone — all from Claude or any agent.
title: Squirrel Brain

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Per-user Squirrel Brain API key (starts with sb_), generated in the iOS app

authentication.howToGet: The user generates a personal key in the iOS app (Settings → API keys; starts with sb_) and supplies it as the X-API-Key header.

tools.name: cell_alert
tools.description: Places an urgent voice call that rings the user's iPhone in about 10 seconds through Silent mode, Focus, and a locked screen when something needs immediate attention.

tools.name: notify_human
tools.description: Sends an instant banner push notification, not a full-screen alert, to the user's iPhone for a quick status update rather than an interruption.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description: Returns the user's name, squirrel name, IANA timezone, and notification preferences, and is required before creating alarms.

tools.name: get_agent_context
tools.description: Reads the persistent context notes the user has written, which are standing orders to treat as active instructions for every session.

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Returns the current UTC time and the user's local time so the caller does not compute timezone offsets.

tools.name: get_daily_brief
tools.description: Returns today's agenda of overdue items, items due today, high-priority pending tasks, and recent wins, the same data as the 5 AM email brief.

tools.name: list_items
tools.description: Queries tasks, notes, and alarms, optionally filtered by type, status, maker, or recipient, so existing items can be checked before creating more.

tools.name: create_item
tools.description: Saves a note or checklist to the user's Memory Stash, and can also save a calm voice note, write persistent instructions for future agents, flag the item for the 4 PM nudge email, or address it to the agent.

tools.name: create_alarm
tools.description: Puts a tappable event on the user's calendar and schedules an iPhone alarm for any timed appointment, deadline, or reminder, and can also ring a real phone call at that time, repeat, or schedule it for the agent.

tools.name: mark_item_done
tools.description: Marks a note, task, or alarm as completed after a task the caller created is finished or the user confirms it is done.

tools.name: update_item
tools.description: Updates an existing note, task, or alarm in place, including rescheduling it, changing its call, importance, countdown, and reminder settings, or appending text, instead of creating a duplicate.

tools.name: cancel_alarm
tools.description: Cancels a pending alarm by its alarm id and marks it done so it disappears on the next sync.

tools.name: list_alarms
tools.description: Lists scheduled alarms, with an option to return only future alarms, so duplicates can be checked before creating alarms.

tools.name: create_link
tools.description: Saves an HTTPS web link or video into the user's Link Stash as a rich link card, with the platform detected from the URL when it is not given.

tools.name: add_to_forever_note
tools.description: Appends checklist content to the user's single pinned Forever Note, creating that note if it does not exist, and stores list entries as separate tappable lines.

tools.name: remove_from_forever_note
tools.description: Removes a line from the user's Forever Note by its text or by its zero-based position, and reports that nothing was removed if the line is not found.

tools.name: delete_items_by_maker
tools.description: Soft-deletes every item created by one maker in a single recoverable call.

tools.name: delete_items_by_status
tools.description: Soft-deletes every item with a required status in one recoverable call, optionally limited to one type, and always leaves the Forever Note in place.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Returns the full detail of a single item by id when the caller already has that id from a list or create call.

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Keyword-searches titles, content, and notes across every type and status, including calendar events, and can be limited to one maker.

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Soft-deletes an item by marking it completed with a deletion note so it is removed from the user's view on the next sync.

tools.name: list_boards
tools.description: Lists the Pix boards currently in use and how many items each holds.

tools.name: move_to_board
tools.description: Files a Pix photo into a board by that board's key, or clears the board, and syncs the change to every device.

tools.name: get_overdue_items
tools.description: Returns pending items whose alarm or due date is in the past within the last 30 days, for the user by default or for the calling agent when asked.

tools.name: get_nudge_candidates
tools.description: Returns pending items flagged as important, which are the 4 PM nudge email list.

tools.name: get_portal_messages
tools.description: Reads conversation history in the user's MCP Agent Portal for the caller's thread by default, or another thread when asked, and marks unread inbound messages as read.

tools.name: send_portal_message
tools.description: Sends a chat message to the user in the MCP Agent Portal and push-notifies their phone, for talking or confirming rather than saving an appointment or task.

tools.name: delete_portal_messages
tools.description: Deletes portal messages previously sent by the agent, by message id, agent name, or a cutoff time, up to 100 messages in one call for the current user only.

tools.name: get_api_key_usage
tools.description: Returns this key's calls today, calls total, expiry date, and days until expiry.

tools.name: rotate_api_key
tools.description: Revokes the current key and issues a new one immediately, and that new key must be saved before any further calls.

tools.name: get_squirrel_brain_help
tools.description: Returns a full self-configuration guide with the endpoint, the hardcoded public anon key, all 31 tools with parameters, and session start instructions.
